extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection: the user-controlled 'name' query parameter (line 19) is interpolated into 'content' (line 38), which is then passed as the template source to jinja2 Template(content).render(). An attacker can supply Jinja2 expressions such as {{7*6}} or {{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()}} to achieve arbitrary code execution on the server.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: Reflected XSS: the 'name' query parameter (line 19) and the externally fetched 'public_ip' text are interpolated unescaped into an HTML string served with response_class=HTMLResponse. Even plain text (no Jinja syntax) such as <script>alert(1)</script> in the 'name' parameter is rendered as raw HTML in the victim's browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
